rounds.text: Regency Fincorp is currently demonstrating exceptional operational momentum, evidenced by compounded sales growth of 82% and profit growth of 165% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15]. This performance is backed by high-quality earnings, as the company achieved a cash conversion ratio of 2.08x in March 2026, ensuring that reported profits are fully supported by actual cash flow [E24]. The company is significantly outperforming its sector peers, delivering an ROE of 12.57% and an ROA of 3.34%, which comfortably exceed the respective sector benchmarks of 5.57% and 1.89% [E8, E9]. Institutional confidence is rising, as evidenced by the entry of both foreign and domestic institutions into the shareholding structure since December 2023, resulting in a positive money flow signal [E32, E33, E34]. Conceded: the company faces leverage risks with debt rising to Rs 504 Cr and a debt-to-equity ratio of 2.64x [E27, E29], and operating margins have shown inconsistency and contraction compared to three years ago [E20, E22]. Despite these concerns, the business is operating within a sector tailwind that supports its aggressive growth trajectory [E51, E53].
